notes:
I found three real options in Halton Hills. Each comes from the operator's own page. These are only what their sites say.

**1. Parent and Tot 18 months - 3.11 yrs, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre (Georgetown)**
- 
Parents take part, and a coach leads a warm-up, games, music and circuits on all the gymnastics events. Each class is 30 minutes.

- 
The Fall 2026 session runs 13 weeks, September 12 to December 18, and registration opened July 20.

- Their fall schedule PDF lists several weekly time slots for this age. The columns didn't read cleanly, so I haven't matched a time to a day.
- I found no price on the page I read.

**2. Pre-school Drop In (4 and under), Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre**
- 
It costs $15 for one parent and up to 4 children. No pre-registration is needed, and you can pay in person.

- 
Days and times are Tuesday and Thursday, 9:30 am to 12:00 pm.

- 
It is first come, and numbers in the facility are limited.

- The page's date range reads "October 9 till June 26, 2026", which may be left over from last year. 
Their Fall 2026 schedule PDF also lists a preschool drop-in at $15 per adult for up to 4 kids, 9:30-12:00.
 It's worth a call to 905-877-4330 to confirm.

**3. Drop-in swimming lessons (Parent and Tot), Town of Halton Hills**
- 
It is designed for beginner swimmers from 4 months to 5 years, and a parent or guardian joins in.

- 
The Fall 2026 sessions are Tuesday or Thursday, 10:00 to 10:30 a.m., running September 22 to December 29, 2026.

- I did not find a price or a pool location in what I read.
